nodes.label: nettop one-shot polling per tick
nodes.rationale: nettop is the only non-private source of per-process network bytes. One ~30 ms `nettop -L 1` run per tick is used because streaming mode (`-L 0`) spins at >100% CPU.

nodes.label: Per-process network via nettop once per cycle
nodes.norm_label: per-process network via nettop once per cycle
nodes.rationale: Per-process network stats are obtained by running nettop once per sampling cycle (~30 ms).

nodes.label: Cumulative-counter delta rate
nodes.rationale: Kernel/IOKit expose cumulative counters; samplers keep the previous reading and divide the delta by elapsed seconds. Rate is 0 on first sample or if the counter went backwards (pid reuse is guarded by comparing process start time).

nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: dmg background as symlinks into brand/
nodes.rationale: dmgbuild follows symlinks; the @2x symlink performs the -2x to @2x rename the handoff asks for without duplicating the file. dmgbuild merges 1x+2x into a .background.tiff (DMG ~3 MB instead of 1.2 MB).

nodes.label: Icon layers are transformed copies, not symlinks
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: icon layers are transformed copies, not symlinks
nodes.rationale: actool's Icon Composer exporter fails with symlinks inside a .icon (status 255, seen in openvault). The handoff draws on the classic 1024 canvas with an 824 squircle at (100,100), but in Icon Composer the full 1024 canvas is the squircle, so the figure is wrapped in scale(1024/824) translate(-100 -100). The 8% inner border is dropped because Liquid Glass adds its own specular rim.

nodes.label: Menu bar glyph redrawn in code instead of loading the PNG
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: menu bar glyph redrawn in code instead of loading the png
nodes.rationale: The spec wants a live glyph (bar height = 2 + load x 12 pt per core group), so an NSImage template is drawn on every tick with the SVG's geometry. The suggested 0.3 s animation is not implemented because a MenuBarExtra label is a static image.

nodes.label: Brand assets not used yet (light/glassdark/tinted PNGs, hero, Open Graph, Manrope)
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: brand assets not used yet (light/glassdark/tinted pngs, hero, open graph, manrope)
nodes.rationale: On macOS 26+ the system generates dark and tinted icon variants from the .icon layers; PNGs stay as reference for web/press. Hero and Open Graph are described but not delivered as PNG. Manrope only appears baked into the DMG background; the app uses the system font.

nodes.label: Menu bar glyph redrawn per tick without easing
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: menu bar glyph redrawn per tick without easing
nodes.rationale: The five-bar template glyph is redrawn every tick without the 0.3 s ease the brand spec suggests because an NSImage label can't animate; a custom NSStatusItem view would be needed if motion matters. Bars never go below 2 pt and fall back to the static template heights before the first sample.

nodes.label: CPU energy estimated from per-process energy
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: cpu energy estimated from per-process energy
nodes.rationale: Recent chips do not expose CPU energy without privileges, so it is estimated by summing the energy reported by each readable process; with the helper installed the sum includes system processes.

nodes.label: Distribution outside the App Store (Developer ID signed, notarized DMG)
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: distribution outside the app store (developer id signed, notarized dmg)
nodes.rationale: A sandboxed app cannot see or manage other users' processes, so the app ships as a Developer ID signed and notarized DMG instead of through the App Store.

nodes.label: Optional privileged helper (SMAppService launch daemon + XPC)
nodes.community_name: OpenProcess README (native open-source Activity Monitor replacement)
nodes.norm_label: optional privileged helper (smappservice launch daemon + xpc)
nodes.rationale: Without the helper all processes are listed but metrics of root/other-user processes show as a dash; the helper exposes those metrics, kills such processes and purges memory. App and helper only talk to each other if both are signed by the same team.

nodes.label: Manual NSTableCellView recycling pool
nodes.rationale: NSOutlineView's own reuse queue never returned the programmatic cells after reloadData(), so removed row cells are pooled per column identifier and reused.

nodes.label: Native NSOutlineView instead of SwiftUI Table
nodes.norm_label: native nsoutlineview instead of swiftui table
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI's Table recreates hosting views whenever rows reorder, costing >10% CPU with ~700 processes sorted by a live metric; an NSViewRepresentable-wrapped NSOutlineView avoids that. Column widths/order are autosaved by AppKit while visibility and sorting live in UIState so the menu bar can drive them.

nodes.label: Occlusion-gated table reload
nodes.rationale: Reload is skipped while the window is closed or fully covered because a hidden table still lays out every row; an occlusion-state notification triggers a reload when it becomes visible again. Stable per-pid Item objects keep expansion state across reloads; sort ties break by pid to avoid jitter.

nodes.label: Native NSOutlineView process table
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI Table spent >10% CPU reordering ~750 rows; the native AppKit table keeps the app at ~6% with the window open and ~2% menu-bar only, refreshing every 2 s.

nodes.label: AppIcon figure layer (02-figura.svg)

nodes.label: Layered icon composition (background + grid + figure)
nodes.description: Design idea: each icon is built from separate stacked layers - a background squircle with gradient, a faint grid, and the five-bar figure on top - so backgrounds and figure (color or mono) can be recombined per appearance and handed to Icon Composer as AppIcon.icon.

nodes.label: Icon appearance variants (light / dark / glass dark / tinted)
nodes.description: Design idea: the same five-bar mark is shipped in four appearances (light, dark, glassdark, tinted), each exported as a 1024px master plus 16-512px renditions, matching macOS icon appearance modes.

nodes.label: Private API graceful degradation (SMC / IOReport / IOHID)
nodes.norm_label: private api graceful degradation (smc / ioreport / iohid)
nodes.rationale: IOReport, IOHIDEventSystemClient and SMC keys are private/undocumented and may change between macOS releases or chips; every source has a failable init and degrades to nil so the UI shows the metric as unavailable instead of crashing.

nodes.label: Private Apple APIs with graceful degradation (IOReport, SMC, IOHIDEventSystemClient)
nodes.norm_label: private apple apis with graceful degradation (ioreport, smc, iohideventsystemclient)
nodes.rationale: GPU energy, total system power and temperatures rely on private APIs; if they break in a future macOS that information is hidden and the rest of the app keeps working.
